page.overview:
Who is Joy Boy?

Joy Boy was a man from the Great Kingdom born 900 years ago at the start of the Void Century, as well as the first pirate in history. An extremely relevant figure in the Void Century, Joy Boy was a chief opponent of the alliance that would eventually become the World Government in the Great War. He played an important role in the history of Fish-Man Island and left behind a vast treasure on the last island of the Grand Line, thus becoming a legendary figure in the world.

Joy Boy's Devil Fruit allowed him to transform into the legendary "Sun God" Nika, causing him to become a key part of the figure's mythos. Following his death, this Devil Fruit eluded capture for eight centuries until being consumed by Monkey D. Luffy. When Luffy awakened the fruit 12 years later, Zunesha proclaimed that Joy Boy had returned. In this form, Luffy has been given the "Joy Boy" moniker by Emet and Nerona Imu, who both personally knew the original man.

He was first mentioned on the Poneglyph read by Nico Robin while at the Sea Forest.

Joy Boy has been noted to strike a strong resemblance to Monkey D. Luffy by Emet. He has only been shown as a silhouette so far, during which he appeared to be wearing a wide-brimmed hat resembling a straw hat, capri pants, and a cape. He also had somewhat messy hair, with several ends jutting out.
